title: Chapter 58 Resurrection Coin
content:
Chapter 58 Resurrection Coin

After exploring the river, Wang Shuo planned to go east from the south, take another walk, and then return to the village.

The grassland in the south is a natural high-quality pasture. Where there is water, there are lush aquatic plants.

However, the shelters Wang Shuo saw on the grassland were basically abandoned. These refugees were either killed or fled on their own initiative.

Along the way, Wang Shuo found several places shrouded in system fog, and there must be hidden dangers inside.

Wang Shuo wanted to eliminate the danger in advance, but he couldn't enter the fog area at all.

After discussing with Chang Gui, he had no way. It seemed that he could only wait until the fog dissipated before making plans.

What was worthy of Wang Shuo's joy was that during the exploration, Wang Shuo also found several iron and coal mines.

But he didn't explore them in depth. He planned to mine them when he had enough manpower and safety was guaranteed.

There is another copy in the hills in the east, and the dazzling light gate can be seen from a long distance.

Similarly, Wang Shuo did not enter. His main task at present was to gather refugees. After a day of searching, Wang Shuo brought back 35 people.

One of them surprised Wang Shuo. It was Duan Wenxi, who had always wanted to worship him as the boss.

When Duan Wenxi saw Wang Shuo, he surrendered directly, calling him the boss.

"Boss, you finally found me!" Duan Wenxi cried to Wang Shuo with snot and tears, and his voice was full of endless surprise.

This made Wang Shuo a little embarrassed.

However, Duan Wenxi did not feel embarrassed. Although the two had never met, they had been friends for a long time.

Wang Shuo was alert.

However, he did not seem to be pretending, so he just let it go along the way.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo asked this group of refugees to join Wana Village according to the old rules. Duan Wenxi was no exception and confiscated all the supplies.

Unexpectedly, he did not hesitate at all, which greatly increased Wang Shuo's favorability.

Moreover, his loyalty is 91, which is second only to those who were frightened in the morning.

At present, Wang Shuo still relies on the "Thought Stamp Scroll" to get 100% loyalty from his subordinates. Unfortunately, it is not available for the time being.

Duan Wenxi's loyalty is above 90, which is already very high. Wang Shuo plans to observe him and then entrust him with important tasks.

Although his strong support for Wang Shuo is suspected of being a lackey, it still plays a positive role in the current situation.

So Wang Shuo did not assign him to the reserve group. One of the important reasons is his life occupation.

When Wang Shuo asked him, he refused to say it.

As a last resort, Wang Shuo had to check his attribute panel directly.

He found that this kid was only level 2, but he actually understood the life skill of "flattering".

This made Wang Shuo laugh so hard that tears fell.

"Boss, why are you like this? My skill is useful and can be upgraded." Duan Wenxi looked proud.

"You are not good at anything, but you are the best at flattering people!" Wang Shuo joked.

"Boss, you are wrong. I am very good at picking up girls. Back then, I was..."

Duan Wenxi said a lot of things, boasting about his glorious history!

Duan Wenxi looks only 17 or 18 years old, and he is handsome, but he said that he had sex seven times a night, which is a bit ridiculous!

Moreover, in this world, picking up girls is useless!

After chatting with Duan Wenxi for a while, Wang Shuo remembered that there were still some things to deal with, so he asked Xiaona to arrange a room in the courtyard so that he could have a good rest. There are still many things to do tomorrow.

Guliji and the three brothers of the Gong family can also live in the courtyard. Except for Duan Wenxi, the loyalty of others is already full.

After Duan Wenxi left, Wang Shuo began to sort out the supplies he got today.

[Wood +31254, Stone +25876, Iron Ore +16215, Soul Crystal +10, Energy Crystal +6320, Gold Coin +23200]

In addition, there are some special props, farm construction drawings, and farm construction drawings. These are things he already has, and there are some things he doesn't have, such as a employment contract and a military crossbow production drawing.

"Let's see tomorrow if there is a blacksmith among the players. It's time to build a blacksmith shop!"

Wang Shuo took out the silver key and the silver treasure chest he got a long time ago.

Wang Shuo was looking forward to this, the first high-level treasure chest.

"Click", with the turn of the key, the treasure chest opened.

In the empty treasure chest, there was only one coin.

[Resurrection coin: The carrier can have a chance to revive. After death, he can choose to revive on the spot or teleport to revive randomly. ]

Wang Shuo's eyes widened immediately, and he was so excited that he couldn't speak for a while.

This is the first time he knows that he can be resurrected.

It felt like a pie hit him, and it took him a long time to recover.

"You must keep it secret, this is your most important trump card!"

Then, he used the employment contract again.

A list of hired personnel appeared in front of him.

With the experience with Zhao Bangde, Wang Shuo did not find it strange at this moment.

The list of personnel on the list was classified according to different professions, including life professions and combat professions.

Wang Shuo looked directly at the combat profession. The first one was a junior general, and the recruitment price was 10 soul crystals plus 30,000 gold coins.

Seeing this price, Wang Shuo swallowed his saliva, it was too brutal.

This was the first time he saw that he could directly summon a general and click on the attributes.

[ID: 3654 Tiar]

[Level: Level 25]

[Profession: General (Primary)]

[Strength: 35]

[Constitution: 28]

[Agility: 27]

[Energy: 36]

It was really like a little cow riding a rocket - awesome!

Then Wang Shuo browsed other names, and finally he found a blacksmith.

[ID: 3275 Matar]

[Level: Level 21]

[Constitution: Blacksmith (Intermediate)]

[Strength: 29]

[Constitution: 21]

[Agility: 16]

[Energy: 18]

When Wang Shuo saw Matar, his eyes lit up.

He still had a flame gun blueprint, but he hadn't made it yet. This intermediate blacksmith should be no problem!

He looked at his recruitment price, which was much cheaper than that general.

One is to improve combat effectiveness immediately, and the other is to obtain excellent equipment continuously. Wang Shuo was in a dilemma.

Finally, Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and chose Matar.

Just when Wang Shuo clicked to recruit, a system prompt popped up:

[Matar will temporarily join your village and work for you for 1 year, or until your territory is destroyed. ]

[During this period, malicious forced labor is not allowed. If a dispute occurs between the two parties, he can choose to refund half of the fee and terminate the recruitment. ]

Is this possible?

Could it be that this Matar is just a wage earner?

[Are you sure you want to hire Matar? ]

"Yes."

[Soul Crystal -4, Gold Coins -20,000]

A light gate appeared in front of Wang Shuo, and soon a dark-skinned man walked out of it.
